preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 50000.
Each test case must have at least 2 sets and at most 100000 sets.
Each set must contain at least 2 integers and at most 100000 integers.
Each integer in the sets must be between 1 and 10^9.
The total number of elements in all sets across all test cases must not exceed 200000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If no similar sets are found, output -1; otherwise, output two distinct indices of similar sets.

postconditions.expression: any(len(set1 & set2) >= 2 for set1 in sets for set2 in sets if set1 != set2)
postconditions.description: If similar sets exist, at least one pair of sets must share at least two common elements.
